rules: Numbers must be strictly limited from 0 up to 20.
Focus heavily on counting forward/backward, recognizing number words, and tracking one more / one less.
Addition and subtraction calculations must stay within 20.
Word problems must be simple, 1-step stories using physical objects.
numbers_and_counting.solution_steps: 1. Identify the starting number value. 2. Count forward (for addition) or backward (for subtraction) by the second amount. 3. Write down the final counting total.

rules: Shapes are strictly limited to basic 2D flat geometric objects: circles, squares, rectangles, and triangles.
Include naming shapes, sorting them by size or color, and identifying simple symmetry in daily objects.
Include using positional language (e.g., next to, behind, inside).
shapes_and_geometry.solution_steps: 1. Look at the edges and properties of the shape visually. 2. Match it to its standard geometric label name. 3. State the correct classification or position.
